sources.title: How to Run MTP Models: Multi-Token Prediction Guide - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: MTP, or Multi-Token Prediction, speeds up inference by letting a model predict multiple upcoming tokens at once instead of generating one token per step. It enables faster inference without accuracy loss and is especially effective on GPUs. In this guide, you'll learn how to use MTP models like Gemma 4 or Qwen3.6 on your local device.
